studies.Title: V89L polymorphism of the 5alpha-reductase Type II gene (SRD5A2), endogenous sex hormones, and prostate cancer risk.
studies.Reference: V89L polymorphism of the 5alpha-reductase Type II gene (SRD5A2), endogenous sex hormones, and prostate cancer risk.

studies.comparison_type: Above-median versus at-or-below-median serum DHEAS among men with an L/L or V/L genotype

extraction_supporting_text.effect_size: However, in L/L or V/L men, above-median DHEAS levels were associated with an increased risk of aggressive tumors [odds ratios (OR), 3.12; 95% confidence interval (95% CI), 1.28-7.63] but not of nonaggressive ones (OR, 0.56; 95% CI, 0.25-1.25).
extraction_supporting_text.cases: We examined the combined effect of circulating sex hormones and SRD5A2 V89L polymorphism on prostate cancer risk in a case-control study (300 cases and 300 controls) nested within the Carotene and Retinol Efficacy Trial.
